media.title: Lys Gauty — portrait, 1934
media.description: Press portrait of the singer Lys Gauty, made in 1934, the year of “Le bistrot du port”, the valse written for her and published under the pseudonym Pierre Candel.
media.altText: A woman seated in a dark hat and a wide fur stole, smiling slightly towards the camera, white gloves and a handbag on her lap and a patterned curtain behind her.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. The photograph comes from the Meurisse press-agency collection at the Bibliothèque nationale de France, which publishes it free of known copyright restrictions.
media.publicCaption: Lys Gauty in a press photograph of 1934, the year “Le bistrot du port” was written for her.
